title: Roast Anything: A Bilingual Roast-Generation Benchmark
description:
A bilingual benchmark for roast generation and humor judgment, with specificity and truth gates, judge validation, and pilot results.

This archive includes benchmark code and public benchmark data. The reserved house-style skill and fiction references are excluded. Code is MIT-licensed, and benchmark data and documentation are CC BY 4.0 under LICENSE. Referenced external datasets retain their own terms.
